title: cross-variant sample suite and pinning strategy for hw profiles
creator: Marco Diaz
description:
Goal: define and publish a repeatable, signed performance-profile artifact and a conservative pinning strategy that covers cross-variant behaviour for A100/H100/L40S/MI300 families. This ticket creates the canonical cross-variant sample-suite, the publication format (v2), and an operational canary + rollback plan for model onboarding and auto-pin recommendations.

Why this is needed:
- Existing per-device benchmarks vary in workload shape; we need a representative suite that surfaces regressions caused by kernel selection, quantization, and KV-cache behavior across device families.
- Profile artifacts must be concise, signed, and consumable by the catalog + runtime to support safe auto-pinning and fallback.
- Pin TTLs and staged rollout rules are necessary to avoid oscillation when new hardware firmware/kernel changes arrive.

Scope:
- Design a cross-variant sample-suite (mix of chat, long-context completion, embedding batch sizes) and a runner that can target the four GPU families.
- Specify profile artifact v2 (CSV + JSON metadata + SHA256 signature) and CI signing workflow.
- Define pin strategy: initial conservative pin, canary percentage, rollback triggers (latency/cost/regression thresholds), and TTL/decay rules.
- Produce sample profiles for 3 onboarding models and publish to internal model-catalog for runtime consumption.
artifact_format: CSV rows: model, variant, hw_tag, seq_len_p50_ms, seq_len_p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_100k_tokens_usd; Metadata JSON: profile_version, generated_by, commit_hash, hw_firmware, quantization, sample_suite_id; signed using CI private key -> SHA256 signature string
acceptance_criteria: A canonical cross-variant sample-suite exists that covers: chat-short (<=128), chat-long (>=4096), embedding-batch (1,8,32), reranking workload; runner can target A100/H100/L40S/MI300
Profile artifact v2 spec is documented (CSV + metadata JSON + signature) and accepted by runtime team
CI job created to run suite nightly for each hw family and publish signed profile artifacts to model-catalog-staging
Pinning policy documented: initial pin TTL=14d, canary rollout 5%->25%->100% with automated rollback on p95 latency regressions >20% or quality drop >2%
Three onboarding models have profiles generated and consumed by a canary runtime; telemetry validates profiles are used and fallbacks work as intended
steps: Draft sample-suite (list of prompts, lengths, batch mixes) and validate on a single hw variant
Implement runner extensions to target per-hw kernel flags and record per-token metrics + system metrics (gpu_util, power, temp)
Iterate artifact schema with runtime and catalog owners, land spec doc in Confluence
Add CI pipeline to run suite across hw images and sign artifacts, push to staging catalog
Coordinate canary rollout with Dedicated/Dedicated-ops: 5% traffic, monitor for 72h, expand if stable
Finalize documentation, add alerts and rollback playbook, and schedule weekly re-run cadence
